name: Higano Shun
source:
A joker and easygoing café manager.

He is the manager of the café attached to L&L. A former child actor, he appeared in numerous commercials and films but left showbiz as he grew older. With his playful and frank personality, he’s easy to get along with, even upon first meeting.
